name: @rozie-ui/combobox
comment:exports: vendorable: true (D-02 / P3). A vendorable primitive exposes its canonical .rozie source under a STABLE subpath so the D-07 <components> specifier `@rozie-ui/combobox/Combobox.rozie` resolves via ProducerResolver (enhanced-resolve, exportsFields:['exports']) for every NON-codegen consumer — the VR harness, the IDE LSP, and any consumer that compiles the composite from raw source. command-palette vendors this primitive (P3/D-03). Codegen itself remaps the specifier to the local vendored sibling in-memory before compile.

scripts.typecheck: echo 'meta-pkg: pure-Rozie source; the emitted leaves typecheck individually, the surface gate runs under vitest'

comment:headless-core-devdep: Phase 64 (D-06 / P3): @rozie-ui/headless-core is a SOURCE-ONLY workspace package whose `listCore.rzts` script-partial (the option resolvers) DISSOLVES into this family's compiled leaves via inlineScriptPartials() at compile — zero runtime dependency. devDependency (cross-package bare-specifier import resolved at compile-time via the producer exports map; the 64-01 mechanism, no tsconfig paths needed).
comment:virtual-core-dep: Phase 64 (P4 / SC-5): @tanstack/virtual-core is the framework-agnostic windowing state machine the shared windowing.rzts math drives (the data-table precedent — NO per-framework adapter). The compiled leaves import it at runtime when `virtual` is on, so it is a peerDependency of each leaf; here it is a devDependency so the source resolves for codegen + the VR build.
comment:vue-mount-devdeps: seedQuery behavioral test (mount-and-drive, the captcha model-param-shadow.vue.test.ts precedent): imports the committed leaf packages/vue/src/Combobox.vue and mounts it via plain `vue` createApp/h — @vitejs/plugin-vue transforms the SFC, happy-dom supplies the DOM. Versions mirror @rozie-ui/captcha's devDependencies exactly (already-resolved workspace versions, not new packages).
comment:popover-devdep: Phase 86 / Option A (D-01, mirroring Phase 75/data-table's D-05/D-07 precedent): combobox composes @rozie-ui/popover to position the plain (non-grouped, non-virtual) popup via Floating UI — the first TWO-level published-leaf chain (command-palette → combobox → popover). The 6 `@rozie-ui/popover-<target>` packages are REAL devDependencies so pnpm symlinks them into combobox/node_modules — exactly the surface @rozie/core's resolveManifestProducer walks (node_modules UPWARD from dirname(fromFile) = combobox/src). So the authoring/codegen/VR/LSP surface resolves the stable `<components>` specifier `@rozie-ui/popover/Popover.rozie` to the published per-target package's compiled manifest rather than a colocated sibling copy. Each combobox leaf declares `@rozie-ui/popover-<target>` as its own runtime peerDependency (the composition's shipped cost); this transitively becomes a peer of every `@rozie-ui/command-palette-<target>` leaf too, even though command-palette uses `inline` and never floats (a `<components>` reference is a static import). The plain `@rozie-ui/popover` devDependency is kept alongside for the raw-.rozie authoring surface (mirrors data-table keeping plain `@rozie-ui/popover`, and command-palette keeping plain `@rozie-ui/combobox`).
comment:floating-ui-dom-devdep: Plan 86-03: combobox has no direct dependency on @floating-ui/dom (D-01 — combobox composes popover, never a second Floating UI integration) so tests/floating-popover.behavior.test.ts's `vi.mock('@floating-ui/dom', ...)` autoUpdate spy could not resolve the specifier from combobox's own package (pnpm's isolated node_modules — no hoisting) and silently never intercepted the emitted @rozie-ui/popover-vue leaf's own identical import, so every subscription-count assertion read 0 regardless of real behavior. Declared here ONLY as a test-scoped devDependency (never imported by Combobox.rozie or any emitted source) pinned to the exact version popover/package.json already devDependencies — pnpm's content-addressable store resolves both to the SAME physical @floating-ui/dom package, so the spy factory and the popover leaf's own import share one module id and the mock actually intercepts.
